title: Identification of patients with dilated phase of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy using a convolutional neural network applied to multiple, dual, and single lead electrocardiograms
summary: A CNN applied to ECGs identified dilated-phase hypertrophic cardiomyopathy in a retrospective single-center cohort; in the held-out test data the eight-lead AUC was 0.929 and V5 single-lead AUC 0.953. This is a specific diagnostic-validation result, not evidence of clinical deployment. PMC10160501 Methods/Results: Shinken cohort, 17,378 analyzed subjects, 54 dHCM cases, CNN, five-run internal test evaluation and lead comparisons. Small positive cohort and no external validation limit scope. Catalog DCM ECG paper is a different disease/model/cohort, not same result.
